title: Crop Sentinel
description: Notifies you when crops in a configurable radius are fully grown. Supports wheat, carrots, potatoes, beetroot, nether wart, cocoa, and sweet berries.
body:
# Crop Sentinel

**Never miss a harvest again.** Crop Sentinel silently scans crops in a configurable radius around you and sends an action bar notification the moment they're fully grown — including crops from mods.

---

## Features

### Vanilla Crop Detection
Scans a cylinder of configurable radius (default 32 blocks, up to 64) every 4 seconds. Detects all vanilla crops:
- Wheat, Carrots, Potatoes, Beetroot
- Nether Wart
- Cocoa Pods
- Sweet Berries

### Modded Crop Detection *(new in 1.1)*
Automatically detects non-vanilla crops from any mod — no configuration needed. Any block that uses a standard `age` property (the same convention used by most modded crops) is tracked and notified when fully grown.

Works with mods like **Farmer's Delight**, **Pam's HarvestCraft**, and many more out of the box. Can be disabled in the config screen if needed.

### Smart Notifications
Only notifies you once per crop — won't spam you if you stay near a farm. Clears the notification once a crop is harvested so you'll be notified again next time it's ready.

### Periodic Reminders
Optional reminder (default every 60 seconds) to let you know crops are still waiting. Set to 0 to disable.

### Notification Style
- **Action bar** (default) — unobtrusive overlay above the hotbar
- **Chat** — optional additional chat message

### In-Game Config Screen
All settings adjustable in-game. Open with a configurable keybind (unbound by default).

---

## Keybinds

| Action | Default |
|---|---|
| Toggle Crop Sentinel on/off | *(unbound)* |
| Open settings | *(unbound)* |

---

## Configuration

| Setting | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `enabled` | `true` | Master on/off switch |
| `radius` | `32` | Scan radius in blocks (8–64) |
| `scanIntervalTicks` | `80` | Ticks between scans (~4 seconds) |
| `actionBarNotify` | `true` | Show notification in action bar |
| `chatNotify` | `false` | Also send a chat message |
| `reminderIntervalSeconds` | `60` | Seconds between reminders (0 = off) |
| `detectModdedCrops` | `true` | Detect crops from mods |

---

## Requirements
- Minecraft **1.21.11**
- Fabric Loader **0.19.2+**, Quilt, or NeoForge **21.11+**
- Fabric API / QFAPI (Fabric/Quilt only)
